name: Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size of Singletons Plus Empty Set
proof: The singleton subfamily is admissible and has minimum projected teaching-set size $n-1$, giving the lower bound. Every subfamily consists of the empty trace together with at most $m\leq n$ singleton traces. If it contains a singleton, that target has worst projected teaching-set size at most $m-1\leq n-1$; if it contains only the empty trace, its value is zero. Thus every subfamily has minimum projected teaching-set size at most $n-1$, proving equality.
